CustomField.description: Claim과 Placement 간 불일치한 필드를 표시하는 수식 필드.
CustomField.formula: MID( IF( CedantPolicyNo__c <> Placement_lk__r.PolicyNo__c, ", Cedant Policy No.", "" ) & IF( OR( AND(ISBLANK(InceptionDate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.InceptionDate__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(InceptionDate__c)), ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.InceptionDate__c)), InceptionDate__c <> Placement_lk__r.InceptionDate__c ), ", Inception Date", "" ) & IF( OR( AND(ISBLANK(ExpirationDate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.ExpirationDate__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(ExpirationDate__c)), ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.ExpirationDate__c)), ExpirationDate__c <> Placement_lk__r.ExpirationDate__c ), ", Expiration Date", "" ) & IF( OR( AND( ISBLANK(LKShare__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.TotalOrderPct__c)) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(LKShare__c)), ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.TotalOrderPct__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(LKShare__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Placement_lk__r.TotalOrderPct__c)), ROUND(LKShare__c, 6) <> ROUND(Placement_lk__r.TotalOrderPct__c / 100, 6) ) ), ", LK Share(%)", "" ), 3, 9999 )
CustomField.label: Placement Valid Fields
